lines.zh: 嗡嗡作响，腐化能量在体内躁动。
挥动触手，寻找猎物的踪迹。
身体扭曲，追逐你的身影。
发出低沉的嗡嗡声，吸引你的注意。
飘忽不定，如同游荡的灵魂。
触须灵敏，侦测到你的气息。
靠近你，企图吞噬你的意识。
lines.en: Approaching, intent on consuming your mind.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的闪光，试图迷惑你。
lines.en: Weak glow, trying to confuse you.

lines.zh: 触手缠绕，试图阻止你的逃离。
lines.en: Tentacles wrapping, trying to stop your escape.

lines.zh: 我贴着走廊的墙皮滑行。
lines.en: I skim along the corridor's plaster.

lines.zh: 悬停在沙堡上空，缓缓漂移。
lines.en: Hovering above the sandcastle, drifting slowly.
Thin wings cut the stagnant air.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻微摆动，保持平衡。

lines.en: Body swaying, as if in thought.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的滋滋声，自我修复。
身体扭动，寻找合适的猎物。
发出微弱的嗡嗡声，保持警觉。
触手轻轻触碰，感受周围的空气。
lines.en: Tentacles gently touching, feeling the air.

lines.zh: 触须迅速伸展，锁定目标。
我没有脚，只能飘着看你。
lines.en: I have no feet; I can only float and watch you.
Tentacles wrapping, trying to grab you.

lines.zh: 翅膀振动，准备进行攻击。
发出嗡嗡声，警告你不要靠近。
lines.en: Humming, warning you to stay back.

lines.zh: 触手紧紧抓住，试图将你拖走。
lines.en: Tentacles gripping, trying to drag you away.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，似乎在计划攻击。
翅膀振动，发出威胁的嗡嗡声。

lines.en: A wing membrane twitches; its gaze sticks to you.
It tilts its head and watches you a long while.

lines.zh: 空荡的走廊里，它在看你。
lines.en: In the empty corridor, it is looking at you.

lines.zh: 腐化的思维在痛苦中扭曲。
思维的碎片如刀割般痛。
lines.en: Mind shrapnel cuts like a blade.

lines.zh: 思想中的痛苦难以言表。
你的脚步声，让我饿得更快。
lines.en: Your footsteps make me hungry faster.

lines.zh: 你提灯的光，甜得像腐肉。
lines.en: The light of your lantern is sweet as carrion.

lines.zh: 你的能量激起了我的欲望！
我们的碰撞产生了火花！
我飘在半空，撞得你发晕。
lines.en: I hover midair and knock you dizzy.

lines.zh: 你的力量在我面前微不足道！
碰撞让我的触手更加强大！
我在空中飘，脑子是腐的。
lines.en: I drift in the air, my mind rotted.

lines.zh: 这层空气里全是我的同类。
lines.en: This layer of air is full of my kind.
Mate with me and you'll be corrupted!
You can smell it, my kind!

lines.zh: 我们的灵魂将合二为一！
我咬住你的影子吸一口。
lines.en: I bite your shadow and drink once.

lines.zh: 空中一振翅，尖叫跟着来。
lines.en: One beat of my wings brings the scream.

lines.zh: 我在空中扇翅膀，脑子已经烂了。
lines.en: I beat my wings in the air, my mind already rotted.
At the corridor's end, it recognizes you.
Your shadow falls on the sand.

lines.zh: 它听到你踩碎玻璃的声音。
lines.en: It heard you step on broken glass.

lines.zh: 这层楼只剩你一个活物。
lines.en: On this floor you are the only living thing.
It slips in through the window gap.
A low hum locks onto you.

lines.zh: 薄翅一振，我锁住你的后颈。
lines.en: One beat of my thin wings, and I fix on your nape.

lines.zh: 尖叫还没出口，我已在上面。
lines.en: Before your scream leaves you, I am above.

lines.zh: 我在天花板下方跟着你的头。
lines.en: I follow your head from beneath the ceiling.
Six points of life, and it still dives at you.

lines.zh: 翅膀的影子压在你脸上。
lines.en: A wing's shadow falls across your face.
The hall's echo helps it aim.
It hugs the ceiling and closes in.
The corrupted hum pours into your ears.
It picked the moment you were most tired.

lines.zh: 沙堡的走廊只有一条路。
lines.en: The sandcastle corridor has only one way.
It aims for the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 你的意识被我撕下一块。
lines.en: I tear a piece off your mind.

lines.zh: 沙堡的墙把我弹回你身上。
lines.en: The sandcastle wall bounces me back onto you.

lines.zh: 我没脚，只能飘着扑下来。
lines.en: No feet; I can only drift down and strike.

lines.zh: 腐化的翼骨扫过你的耳朵。
lines.en: A corrupted wing bone sweeps past your ear.
Corrupted tentacles! — Corrupted Mind, melee attack

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到比脑袋还大。
lines.en: I open my mouth wider than my own head.
A wing bone rakes your throat.
It hits your chest, light as paper.
Corrupted teeth sink into your fingers.
It flies at your face, clawing your eyes.
One strike is not enough; it comes again.
A tail sting pierces your shoulder.
Sand blinds you, and it bites.
It wraps your neck and beats its wings.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头被啃的声音。

lines.en: This bite lands on your bracer.
It bites, retreats, and tests you.

lines.zh: 空房间里，我先有了翅膀。
lines.en: In the empty room, my wings form first.

lines.zh: 沙堡的窗洞里飞出一只。
lines.en: One flies out of a sandcastle window.
The lights on this floor flicker once.
Wings gather in the empty hall.
It shakes itself free of the sand pile.
Torn apart by explosion, pain unbearable.

lines.zh: 被投射物击中，痛苦难当。

lines.en: Torn apart by magic, pain unbearable.
